formula_or_rule: Sum of 6 organ-system sub-scores, each 0-4 points (total 0-24): Respiration (PaO2/FiO2 ratio, mmHg): >=400=0, <400=1, <300=2, <200 with respiratory support=3, <100 with respiratory support=4. Coagulation (platelets, x10^3/uL): >=150=0, <150=1, <100=2, <50=3, <20=4. Liver (bilirubin, mg/dL): <1.2=0, 1.2-1.9=1, 2.0-5.9=2, 6.0-11.9=3, >=12.0=4. Cardiovascular (MAP or vasopressor doses): MAP>=70=0, MAP<70=1, dopamine<=5 or dobutamine any=2, dopamine>5 or epi/norepi<=0.1=3, dopamine>15 or epi/norepi>0.1=4. CNS (Glasgow Coma Scale): 15=0, 13-14=1, 10-12=2, 6-9=3, <6=4. Renal (creatinine mg/dL or urine output): <1.2=0, 1.2-1.9=1, 2.0-3.4=2, 3.5-4.9 or urine<500mL/day=3, >=5.0 or urine<200mL/day=4.

condition_rules.cardiovascular: vasopressor thresholds only apply if vasopressors are documented as being administered
